state_writes: typed card, token, spell-copy, or card-copy kind
costs: a public-zone move paid as a cost remains linkable by the resolving instruction where CR 400.7j applies
timing: replacement effects are selected before mutation
last-known information is captured before mutation
the destination incarnation exists after mutation
objects moved simultaneously to one destination share one timestamp moment
targets: a target is tied to the selected logical incarnation and does not follow the same physical card through a zone change
choices: contradictory destination effects require the appropriate controller or owner choice
hidden_information: logical incarnation metadata remains authoritative and is not projected as hidden-zone identity
apnap: simultaneous zone-change replacement choices may require APNAP collection
layers: new battlefield objects receive new timestamps and lose prior continuous effects except for explicit CR 400.7 exceptions
replacement_effects: destination replacements transform the same proposed zone-change event before the incarnation advances
copy: copy effects normally end on a zone change; permanent-spell continuation and sticker exceptions remain explicit
control_change: a new battlefield object uses the instructed controller; otherwise a card normally returns to its owner
zone_change: ordinary cross-zone moves create a new logical incarnation
exile-to-exile and command-to-command create new logical incarnations
a permanent spell retains its logical incarnation as it becomes a permanent
source_leaves: stack abilities use last-known information, while targets and linked delayed effects retain only the relationships allowed by CR 400.7

variants: target leaves and returns before resolution
same physical card leaves and returns before a linked delayed effect
sequential zone entries receive increasing timestamp moments
simultaneous zone entries share a timestamp moment
rulings: Ephemerate 2019-06-14: the returned creature is a new object and a token will not return
Cloudshift 2018-03-16: the returned permanent is a new object and a token will not return
Daretti, Scrap Savant 2014-11-07: the delayed return does not follow a card that left and reentered the graveyard

implementation.component: CardInstance.zone_change_counter and zone_timestamp, GameState.timestamp_sequence, CommanderEngine.move_card, target revalidation, and identity-guarded semantic moves

known_blockers: the complete CR 400.7a-m exception matrix is not represented as typed continuation policies
merged permanents, meld components, stickers, and complete face-down object identity are not implemented
turning a face-up command-zone object face down does not yet create a new incarnation
all legacy semantic references have not yet migrated from physical refs to typed logical handles
all simultaneous replacement choices are not yet routed through the CR 616 ordering engine
complete CR 613.7m APNAP relative-timestamp choices are not represented
